note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real database, tape or courier. Every restore time and cost the Backups module shows comes from these.

words.schedule: copies start at 01:00 and repeat every 24, 12, 6 or 1 hours
words.incremental: with incremental copies, each day's first copy is full and the rest keep only what changed
words.restore: a full copy takes 3 hours to read back, and each incremental link 1 more
words.fetch: a warehouse copy takes 2 hours to pull back over the network; the lockbox 6, for the courier to bring it
words.courier: the courier collects a full tape at 18:00 every day
words.test: a test restore reads the newest copy back at 09:00 every day
words.costs: a full copy costs $10 in tape and time, an incremental $2; the warehouse link $40 a week, the courier $70
